summary: LLM Harbor is a containerised toolkit managed through a command-line interface for running large language model backends, APIs, and frontends. It orchestrates multiple GenAI services within a single environment using standard container infrastructure.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a unified command-line tool to quickly spin up various LLM-related services without configuring each component manually.
watchOut: The project relies heavily on shell scripts and container orchestration, which can make debugging complex configuration issues or custom integrations difficult.
deployNotes: Since it uses Docker and shell scripts, you will typically need a host with Docker installed, persistent volumes configured for model weights and data, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
